title: Man City in League Two · Part 5

beats.kicker: Man City in League Two · Part 5
beats.headline: City were [fourth]. Now [champions].
beats.vo: Man City were fourth at halfway. Now they're champions.

beats.kicker: Your vote · the TikTok poll · 785 votes
beats.headline: You voted: [Ward-Prowse].
beats.vo: You voted, and forty-seven percent picked Ward-Prowse.

beats.headline: A comment signed [Moylan]. On loan.

card.text: Make them sign jack moylan from cardiff
card.title: likes on the comment

beats.vo: A comment wanted Jack Moylan. Thirty likes needed. It got nineteen. So: a six-month loan.

beats.headline: The signings: rated [69] and [72].
beats.vo: Ratings: Ward-Prowse, sixty-nine. Moylan, seventy-two. The loan beats your pick.

beats.headline: City: [74%] to win the league.
beats.vo: Title odds at halfway: seventy-four percent. Your signings add seventeen.

beats.headline: Debut day: [1–2] at Stevenage.
beats.vo: Debut day. Stevenage win two–one. City fall to fifth.

beats.headline: Three wins. City go [top].
beats.vo: Three wins. Burnley, five–one. Wycombe, four–three. Burton, two–nil. City go top.

beats.headline: Salford: [6–0]. No Haaland.
beats.vo: Salford. Six–nil. Haaland didn't even play.

beats.kicker: The title race · City v the best of the rest
beats.headline: Then it got [tight].
beats.vo: Then it got tight. Chesterfield win four–three. Plymouth win three–one. Level on points with Stockport.

beats.headline: Cambridge: Haaland [twice].
beats.vo: Then Cambridge. Haaland scores twice. Three–nil. One game to spare, and City are champions.

beats.headline: Champions: [82 points].
beats.vo: Eighty-two points. Ninety-seven goals, the most. Fifty-one against, the fewest. And Haaland: thirty-five.

beats.headline: Going up. The weak spot: [right wing].
beats.vo: City are going up. The weak spot: right wing. Bowen, Cozier-Duberry or Tanner? Who should City sign?

beats.headline: Moylan's loan is [nearly up].
beats.vo: And Moylan's loan is nearly up. Keep him?
